Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0041 1. Remark 2.8\group eternal-solutions

For the cigar soliton, the potential may be taken as $f(s)=a^{-1}\log (\cosh (as))$, and the corresponding soliton vector field is $X=-\nabla f=-\tanh (as)\, \partial _s$.
